description: Experience modern, coastal living in this chic townhome showcasing breathtaking panoramic views of the Bay, Angel Islnd & Bay Bridge. Stunning home combines style & functionality in an open, light-filled layout. Living Area features soaring vaulted ceilings, rich ebony H/W flring & a wall of windows that opens to the stunning blue Bay views beyond and a generous deck for dining/lounging & entertaining.The Living Rm enjoys a wood burning F/P & custom built-in credenza while just a few steps up is the Dining Rm w/bar counter and pass through from Kitchen. An updated Kitchen features gorgeous granite countertops, sleek black appl, lrg pantry & sep eat-in area w/atrium windows that frame beautiful & dramatic views of Mt. Tam.  The living, dining and kitchen spaces all enjoy water views and flow seamlessly to the enormous outdoor deck with soothing water views. Sophisticated Powder Rm also on the living level. All bedrooms are located upstairs as is a separate Bay View room that would be great as an Office/Nursery/Den/Library. The Primary Suite is a serene retreat with custom built-ins, gorgeous Bay views and an en-suite bath with dual sink vanity, skylights and add'l closet. The fully enclosed glassed-in office/nursery/den sits adjacent to the Primary Suite. The second bedroom suite offers beautiful Mt.Tam views and its own private bath, ideal for guests, roommates or family.  Additional features include a 2-car attached garage with abundant storage, updated water heater and interior laundry with side by side washer/dryer.  Perfectly located near the waterfront, this hidden gem is part of a small, congenial 23 townhome community and is located near K-8 schools, a dog park, tennis & pickleball courts and playground.  Fine dining, boutique shopping, and scenic trails are just minutes away!
